content: More formally, a document $d$ can be represented by a vector in $\mathbb {R}^{n}$ , where each dimension represents a different term. A term can be a single word, constituting the conventional bag-of-words, or combinations of $N$ words, constituting the bag-of-N-grams. If a term occurs in the document, its position in the vector will have a non-zero value, also known as term weight. Two documents in the VSM can be compared to each other by taking the cosine distance between them BIBREF1 .
